doc: The ledger of the panel bus (lib/core/panel-bus.js; D-bus-ledger): every message type the pages post or listen to, one entry each -- what it says, who posts it, who takes it, its payload, and how the takers are picked (scope, filter). test/bus-ledger.test.js checks it against the code both ways: a type in the code that is not here, and an entry here that no page, config or pair table names any more. A new message: add its entry here in the same change. The `filter` column is the routing the dock is to take over (D-unified-dock): today each taker narrows by itself.

fields.name: the bus type
fields.scope: how the takers are picked -- see scopes
fields.from: who posts it (panels, skins, the file when it is one)
fields.reply: for a question (ask, or to with an answer): the type of the answer
fields.filter: how the takers narrow an unaddressed message, when they do
fields.note: what is not as usual: no sender now, no taker in the pages, ...

scopes.notice: unaddressed: something happened; every listener may act on it (see filter)
scopes.ask: unaddressed question: every page that can answers with `reply`, carrying the asker's req when it has one
scopes.to: addressed to one bus id (post opts.to; the taker listens with onMine)
scopes.reply: an answer: addressed to the asker (to), or unaddressed and matched by req
scopes.claim: pages of one kind (one per window) say which of them is active; the others step back

messages.desc: not a message: the listener of every type. The work store records the start and end of the pairs in work.json from it
